bio.text: Jennifer Balkcom, a Republican state representative from Henderson County, was selected in August 2026 as her party's candidate for North Carolina's 11th Congressional District.
She has represented District 117 in the North Carolina House since 2023.
WLOS describes her as a small business owner with a background in agriculture, business and banking.

sources.title: NCGOP selects Balkcom as NC-11 candidate after US Rep. Edwards' withdrawal
Jennifer Balkcom picked as Rep. Edwards' replacement in North Carolina congressional race
